## Documents

* [brief.component.md](brief.component.md) - Writes one member's brief: its front matter, the opening instruction, the task, the write set and the return skill's instruction, in that order. A path that does not resolve stops the brief.
* [close.component.md](close.component.md) - Closes a plan. It marks each hop cited or not cited from the parent's transcript, and reports the plan's dispatches, the parts below the line, the override rates, the pending files never dispatched and each fault. It removes nothing.
* [decide.component.md](decide.component.md) - Asks Jev the act, persona and effort decisions for one part, records each request on the ledger, and writes the part's pending triage file. Its override mode records a level or persona the parent passes instead, or a dispatch sent with no persona.
* [dispatch-check.component.md](dispatch-check.component.md) - Refuses a dispatch that no triage reached, with the reason. It lets through a dispatch whose pending file exists, records a failed triage or records a dispatch with no persona, the planner's own dispatch and a member's own. It writes nothing.
* [plan.component.md](plan.component.md) - Writes the plan file before the first dispatch, lists a re-dispatch against its member, and writes the planner's own pending file. A hop the last closed plan of the same pattern marked not cited is left out.
* [stage.component.md](stage.component.md) - Reads a task's stage from named files only: a build specification, a ratified specification, or unrecorded with the reason. Proposals, findings, test criteria and amendments never count. It writes nothing.
* [witness.component.md](witness.component.md) - Checks the ledger is writing for this session before a team's first dispatch, by finding the session-start witness line in the session's own ledger file. With none, the skill stops and says why.
* [worktree-check.component.md](worktree-check.component.md) - Refuses a writer's dispatch whose worktree would not hold its write set as the main checkout has it, or whose write set spans two repositories, with the reason. It writes nothing.
